assets.name: dis-navigation
assets.caption: Custom bitmap navigation: left turn, distance and native approach bar. Sample route, metric units.

assets.name: dis-navigation-approach
assets.caption: Sample route: approach a left turn, continue straight, then approach a right turn. The native bar appears within 300 m and fills as distance falls. This is a rendered sequence, not a road recording.

assets.name: dis-navigation-stock
assets.caption: Stock glyph navigation: production placement of captured OEM icon and bar glyphs. Sample left turn at 250 m; this renderer does not draw the bitmap style distance field.

assets.name: dis-media
assets.caption: Now playing: track, artist, album and playback time. All metadata is made-up demo content.

assets.name: dis-media-scroll
assets.caption: Measured text scrolling keeps a long sample track title inside the display. Short fields remain centered.

assets.name: dis-cover-art
assets.caption: Original geometric demo artwork converted by the production cover-art pipeline. Native 128×96 resolution, balanced preset with ordered dithering.

assets.name: dis-phone
assets.caption: Sample incoming call with wheel control active. The wheel symbol indicates input ownership; Accept is selected.

assets.name: dis-readings
assets.caption: Default Daily readings page: oil temperature, absolute boost, coolant, MAF, intake temperature, RPM, transmission and AWD oil temperature. Synthetic values; support depends on the vehicle and providers.

assets.name: dis-readings-controls
assets.caption: Readings controls: page selection, recording with Stop focused, Mark focused, then idle. Logger state is simulated; the script starts no recording.

assets.name: dis-acceleration
assets.caption: Acceleration page after a simulated run: 0–60 mph, 0–30 mph, 40–70 mph and current speed. Times are synthetic; the header reports tolerance from CAN sample intervals.

assets.name: dis-acceleration-run
assets.caption: Acceleration page from Ready through Timing to Done. Completed rows briefly invert. Production timing logic receives a synthetic 20Hz speed stream; no vehicle run is shown.

assets.name: dis-car-info-legacy
assets.caption: Low-resolution red-cluster Car Info: absolute boost, MAF, ignition timing, oil and coolant. The production five-line view uses the emulator legacy glyph table, enlarged 8x. Synthetic readings.

assets.name: dis-top-media
assets.caption: Two-line top DIS with sample track and artist, each limited to eight fixed-width characters. The production scrollers advance independently, pause at the ends and restart. This image shows the top strip only.
assets.display: 64x23 logical top strip enlarged 8x; no center area
